properties.name_zh: Noonline 午间客厅
properties.design_role: distributed public-space rooms for 11:30-14:30 comfort, work break, and offline help
properties.spatial_rule: Each room keeps a pedestrian clear zone separate from stopping, information, human support and optional AI equipment; actual facilities remain unverified.
properties.ai_off_rule: Physical route recognition, stay-space reservation and human-help locations are primary; AI remains optional.
properties.failure_response: A failed facility, closed entry or unresolved crossing downgrades or removes the associated concept claim rather than being concealed by a digital recommendation.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: The network treats public information, connection and maintenance as spatial infrastructure derived from railway reliability.

properties.name_zh: 众智园服务区固定导向与遮阴预留点 01
properties.name_en: Zhongzhiyuan service-zone fixed-wayfinding and shade-reservation point 01
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation between primary service nodes
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the marker or its maintenance is unavailable, it cannot be counted as support; it never certifies existing shade, seating or water.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A small fixed marker extends legible route continuity without adding a staffed service claim.

properties.name_zh: 众智园服务区固定导向与遮阴预留点 02
properties.name_en: Zhongzhiyuan service-zone fixed-wayfinding and shade-reservation point 02
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation between primary service nodes
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the marker or its maintenance is unavailable, it cannot be counted as support; it never certifies existing shade, seating or water.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A small fixed marker extends legible route continuity without adding a staffed service claim.

properties.name_zh: AI原点主轴固定导向与遮阴预留点
properties.name_en: AI Origin spine fixed-wayfinding and shade-reservation point
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation between primary civic-room nodes
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the marker or its maintenance is unavailable, it cannot be counted as support; it never certifies existing shade, seating or water.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A fixed, low-tech information point keeps public knowledge readable without a screen.

properties.name_zh: AI原点横向接驳固定导向点
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation on the lateral connector
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the lateral edge or marker is unavailable, declare the route break rather than relying on dynamic direction.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: An interconnection stays legible through fixed direction and a maintainable public cue.

properties.name_zh: AI原点南侧固定导向与遮阴预留点
properties.name_en: AI Origin south fixed-wayfinding and shade-reservation point
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation between the south crossing interface and the civic-room node
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the marker or its maintenance is unavailable, it cannot be counted as support; it never certifies existing shade, seating or water.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A fixed, low-tech information point keeps public knowledge readable without a screen.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺轨道接驳固定导向点
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation on the transit connector
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the marker or its maintenance is unavailable, it cannot be counted as support; it never certifies existing shade, seating or water.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Transfer direction remains public and readable before optional digital assistance.

properties.name_zh: 众智园测试横向固定导向与遮阴预留点
properties.name_en: Zhongzhiyuan test-lateral fixed-wayfinding and shade-reservation point
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation between the research-test porch and rest-check node
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the marker or its maintenance is unavailable, it cannot be counted as support; it never certifies existing shade, seating or water.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Support points mark an observable and maintainable threshold, not a test permit.

properties.name_zh: 众智园公共入口横向固定导向与遮阴预留点
properties.name_en: Zhongzhiyuan public-entry lateral fixed-wayfinding and shade-reservation point
properties.service_role: non-staffed fixed wayfinding and future shade/rest reservation between the walking buffer and public-entry porch
properties.ai_off_role: a fixed physical marker remains readable without AI or a screen
properties.failure_response: If the marker or its maintenance is unavailable, it cannot be counted as support; it never certifies existing shade, seating or water.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A fixed cue makes the public route clear before a controlled interface begins.

properties.name_zh: 众智园研发测试门廊入口
properties.service_role: main-spine entry to a visible research and testing interface
properties.ai_off_role: fixed entry marker and physical route remain readable without AI or a screen
properties.spatial_sequence_position: public arrival before observation and controlled test layers
properties.ai_role: optional test-status interpretation outside the public clearway
properties.failure_response: Keep the public entry and bypass readable; stop the test display if the buffer or operator responsibility fails.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A legible entry and accountable handover make engineering reliability a public-space rule.

properties.name_zh: 众智园测试休息与人工核验点
properties.service_role: rest, water and staffed verification interface for research-test users
properties.ai_off_role: conceptual seat, water provision and visible human enquiry point remain usable as physical services
properties.siting_rule: end of research-test interface and turning point
properties.spatial_sequence_position: observation/stay edge before the controlled test boundary
properties.ai_role: optional explanation of a test or service status
properties.failure_response: If seating, water or staffing cannot be maintained, remove those service claims and retain route orientation plus F01 handoff.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A maintainable pause-and-check point makes verification visible without turning it into a spectacle.

properties.name_zh: 众智园公共入口门廊
properties.service_role: public entrance with fixed orientation and research-test welcome interface
properties.ai_off_role: durable bilingual sign and open public threshold provide offline orientation
properties.siting_rule: public-entry interface at the end of the north access segment
properties.spatial_sequence_position: public entry before the research-test interface
properties.failure_response: If a public opening cannot be confirmed, remove the entry claim and direct users to the main-spine public edge.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Entry information is physical and readable before it becomes intelligent.

properties.name_zh: 众智园测试活动步行缓冲点
properties.service_role: buffer between test activity and ordinary pedestrian continuity
properties.ai_off_role: fixed route marker and marked pedestrian buffer protect a readable walking path
properties.spatial_sequence_position: clearway transition where public movement is protected from test activity
properties.ai_role: optional occupancy warning that cannot replace the buffer
properties.failure_response: If public movement and testing conflict, stop or relocate testing; do not reroute pedestrians through the controlled layer.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Safe separation and a visible contingency path convert operational discipline into civic trust.

properties.name_zh: AI原点公共客厅休息与饮水点
properties.name_en: AI Origin civic-room rest and water point
properties.service_role: public living-room pause, water and human enquiry point
properties.ai_off_role: seats, water and a visible staffed desk are designed as independent physical services
properties.siting_rule: main-spine, lateral connector and public-entry convergence
properties.spatial_sequence_position: central sitting and asking room after entry and physical information
properties.ai_role: optional translation, explanation and public-feedback synthesis
properties.failure_response: If seating, water or staffing cannot be maintained, reduce the service claim but retain static information and an exit route.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Public connection becomes a place to stop, understand and ask rather than a pass-through display.

properties.name_zh: 京张历史—AI文化解释点
properties.name_en: Jing-Zhang history and AI culture interpretation point
properties.service_role: offline-readable bridge between railway memory and AI public culture
properties.ai_off_role: fixed bilingual interpretation surface remains readable without phone, AI or screen
properties.siting_rule: transition between civic-room segment and northern connector
properties.spatial_sequence_position: readable bridge between corridor memory and the civic room
properties.ai_role: optional multilingual interpretation beside a complete physical information surface
properties.failure_response: If interpretation rights or maintenance are unavailable, remove the content claim and keep only confirmed route orientation.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Engineering history is translated into readable direction, standards and maintenance responsibility, not an invented heritage object.

properties.name_zh: AI原点横向接驳休息点
properties.name_en: AI Origin lateral rest and crossing point
properties.service_role: short transverse pause and crossing decision point
properties.ai_off_role: fixed directional sign, seat and human help keep the lateral route usable
properties.siting_rule: outer end of the east-west lateral connector
properties.spatial_sequence_position: lateral pause and decision point linked to the civic room
properties.ai_role: optional routing advisory after physical directions and human help are present
properties.failure_response: If a crossing or accessible alternative is not verified, label the route break and redirect only to a confirmed public edge.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A secondary connection remains legible through fixed information and responsible handover.

properties.name_zh: AI原点双语公共入口
properties.service_role: clear public threshold for visitors, residents and international exchange
properties.ai_off_role: fixed bilingual sign and physical forecourt provide entry orientation without AI
properties.siting_rule: outer end of the public-entry connector
properties.spatial_sequence_position: public entrance before the knowledge line and sitting room
properties.ai_role: optional arrival translation that cannot gate entry or use
properties.failure_response: If public entry is closed or unmaintainable, relocate the information to a confirmed public edge and remove the entry claim.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Low-threshold public access begins with a readable physical threshold.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺午间商务休息与饮水点
properties.name_en: Dazhongsi business-lunch rest and water point
properties.service_role: fast lunch pause and route-transfer support at the southern section junction
properties.ai_off_role: visible seat, water and staffed route advice remain as physical lunch services
properties.siting_rule: main-spine, transit access and crossing breakpoint convergence
properties.spatial_sequence_position: short stay after arrival and before the crossing or service frontage decision
properties.ai_role: optional queue, service or disruption indication that remains subordinate to physical directions
properties.failure_response: If rest, water or staff cannot be maintained, remove the service claim and retain fixed orientation to a confirmed alternative.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A reliable arrival chain includes a pause, an understandable choice and accountable assistance.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺过街与无障碍绕行点
properties.service_role: crossing wait and accessible alternative decision point between rail arrival and the spine
properties.ai_off_role: fixed crossing notice and marked accessible alternative remain legible without dynamic guidance
properties.spatial_sequence_position: decision point between rail arrival and the public service spine
properties.ai_role: optional disruption notice that cannot certify safety or accessibility
properties.failure_response: Unverified legality, sightline, detour or access requires reroute or suspension of the rail-transfer continuity claim.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A connection is only reliable when its accessible failure path is explicit.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺轨道到园区午间服务点
properties.service_role: rail arrival, quick rest, water and staffed enquiry at the business interface
properties.ai_off_role: fixed station-to-spine marker, seat, water and human enquiry remain available as concept services
properties.siting_rule: outer rail-access endpoint and arrival threshold
properties.spatial_sequence_position: arrival threshold before orientation, short stay and the crossing decision
properties.ai_role: optional multilingual arrival and service cueing after physical information is present
properties.failure_response: If a station-facing public entry cannot be verified, do not claim direct station access; redirect to a confirmed public arrival edge.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Arrival and directional clarity make rail reliability tangible in everyday life.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺公共入口与活动缓冲点
properties.name_en: Dazhongsi public entry and event buffer
properties.service_role: public-space entry, event-flow buffer and station-touchpoint orientation
properties.ai_off_role: fixed entrance marker and physical waiting edge keep the route understandable without AI
properties.siting_rule: crossing breakpoint at the public-space edge
properties.spatial_sequence_position: public threshold after the crossing decision and before daily service use
properties.ai_role: optional event-flow indication that cannot block the public service edge
properties.failure_response: If event flow obstructs the clearway or access is not public, stop the event interface and retain signed public passage.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A market-facing threshold must preserve public direction and maintenance under peak use.

properties.name_zh: 众智园研发测试人工兜底站
properties.manual_role: research-test registration, route explanation and human verification
properties.ai_off_role: human staff provide route, access and service fallback when AI is off
properties.failure_response: No named duty period or responsible operator means the fallback cannot be claimed; retain fixed signs and stop test display as needed.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Human verification is treated as a maintainable infrastructure role, not an emergency app feature.

properties.name_zh: AI原点公共入口人工问询站
properties.manual_role: bilingual public enquiry, visitor orientation and civic-room access support
properties.ai_off_role: human enquiry remains available at the fixed public threshold without phone or screen
properties.siting_rule: outer end of the AI Origin public-entry connector
properties.failure_response: If no accountable enquiry role or opening condition is confirmed, do not claim staffed support; preserve only static bilingual orientation.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Public connection includes a person who can explain the route when systems fail.

properties.name_zh: AI原点京张记忆过街兜底站
properties.manual_role: heritage interpretation, crossing assistance and accessible route explanation
properties.ai_off_role: staff explain the fixed heritage route and accessible alternative when dynamic guidance is unavailable
properties.siting_rule: heritage crossing interface at the southern edge of the civic-room segment
properties.failure_response: If the crossing or human service is unverified, keep cultural orientation separate from the crossing claim and direct users to a confirmed alternative.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: History is made useful through explainable direction and responsible assistance at a real decision point.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺轨道接驳人工服务站
properties.manual_role: rail arrival, route transfer, crossing and lunch-service assistance
properties.ai_off_role: staff provide human route transfer and accessible-detour help at the network junction
properties.failure_response: If no staff, lawful crossing or acceptable detour can be confirmed, suspend rail-transfer continuity rather than directing users through an unverified path.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Transfer reliability requires an accountable human handover as well as a legible route.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺无障碍绕行与活动秩序站
properties.manual_role: accessible detour guidance and temporary event-flow management
properties.ai_off_role: human staff keep the public-entry edge and accessible alternative understandable without AI
properties.siting_rule: public-space edge at the crossing breakpoint
properties.failure_response: If an event consumes the clearway or no accessible alternative is confirmed, stop the event interface and retain a signed public route only.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Operational continuity is judged by the legibility of the fallback route under peak conditions.
